name: Palladous-Spandrel

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Their vault-cities descend on tethered cables through the cloud decks, harvesting charge from the storms.

description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are bioluminescent seas, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Roads and orbital mirrors betray minds at work, engineering on a civil scale.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
